text:
The billing was unclear. The price list at the counter stated 900 baht for teeth scaling, but they charged 1300 baht. When I argued that the scaling was 1200 baht and the service fee was 100 baht, the employee said the 900 baht was the starting price (which the clinic didn't specify) and was for children.
This was the first time I've encountered a 100 baht service fee charged for every service.

And to use my social security benefits, I had to submit the documents myself for reimbursement.
I only used their services once.
